x-runtimeConstraints: All x-* fields are annotations, not standard JSON Schema validation keywords.
maxLength counts Unicode code points, not UTF-8 bytes. Runtime must enforce every x-maxUTF8Bytes limit after valid UTF-8 handling.
Runtime decoding rejects duplicate decoded keys, trailing documents, invalid UTF-8, unpaired surrogates and non-JSON numeric syntax.
Integer fields require integer JSON tokens without fraction/exponent; JSON Schema integer alone cannot enforce token spelling.
Retained N is in 1..1024 including warmup; observed output counts are each bounded by actual N (cost_events by 2*N).
Calendar D=floor((end-1)/86400000)-floor(start/86400000)+1 is in 1..366; daily length equals D and each year map has at most D entries.

Global E<=732 counts definite and possible midnight elements separately across every closed-trade and terminal exposure. Global G<=1024 counts copied gap objects across those exposures. Per-array schema bounds do not establish aggregate bounds.

Raw must be the unchanged owned Stage A envelope byte segment, including original whitespace and newline. Its $ref is unchanged; parsing, validation or JSON reserialization cannot prove raw-byte preservation or digest correctness.
The combined output is at most 64 MiB and respects the v2 B(N,D,E,G) bound (52429496 bytes at maxima). This is an encoded bound, not a peak-RSS claim.
Economic/lifecycle consistency, cross-field hashes/identities, chronological ordering, timeframe alignment, valid calendar dates and finite ordered arithmetic are B1 runtime obligations.
Fixed outer/policy/error wire key order follows typed Go declarations and requires separate byte tests.
